basic_details.job_title: Majuli University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Assistant Professor, Internal Auditor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Assistant Professor, Department of History, Internal Auditor
basic_details.short_information: Majuli University (MUC), Assam, has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. MUC/RG/Recruit-161/2026/2574. The posts include Assistant Professor, Department of History, Internal Auditor. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft or Online Payment in favour of the Registrar, Majuli University, payable at Punjab National Bank, Garamur Branch, A/c No. 2200010048301, IFSC: PUNB0220020. Last date to pay the fee: 25 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Upper age limit as per Govt. Rule for both posts (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Assistant Professor (History): high Second-Class Master's Degree in any branch of History with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, with specialized knowledge of the historical and religious literature and culture of Assam, and NET/SET pass. Internal Auditor: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce with major in Accountancy, uniformly good academic record, five years' auditing experience and working knowledge of Tally.

vacancy_details.Pay: Rs. 57,700 - Rs. 1,82,400 (and all other admissible allowances)
Rs. 22,000 to 97,000 , GP Rs. 9,700 (and all other admissible allowances)
vacancy_details.Experience: Experience of auditing in A.G. Office/ Director of local Accounts/ reputed C.A. firm/ auditing and accounting in any University for a minimum period of Five Years

post_wise_breakdown.pay: Rs. 57,700 - Rs. 1,82,400 (and all other admissible allowances)
Rs. 22,000 to 97,000 , GP Rs. 9,700 (and all other admissible allowances)
post_wise_breakdown.experience: Experience of auditing in A.G. Office/ Director of local Accounts/ reputed C.A. firm/ auditing and accounting in any University for a minimum period of Five Years

salary_details.pay_scale: Assistant Professor: Rs. 57,700 - Rs. 1,82,400; Internal Auditor: Rs. 22,000 - 97,000 with GP Rs. 9,700; plus all other admissible allowances

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from www.muoc.ac.in; applications in any other form will not be accepted.
Pay the fee by Demand Draft or online payment in favour of the Registrar, Majuli University, payable at Punjab National Bank, Garamur Branch.
Attach three sets of self-attested copies of all testimonials and supporting documents, with the Draft or payment receipt.
Write the name of the post and the Advertisement No. on the envelope.
Send by Speed Post or Registered Post to The Registrar, Majuli University, Main Campus, Manika Pathar, Garamur, Majuli, Assam-785104.
Application must reach on or before 25/11/2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA for appearing in any interview or written test Incomplete applications or applications without relevant enclosures will be rejected University not responsible for postal delay or late receipt of call letters University may withdraw any post or decide not to fill it

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: All posts shall remain purely temporary till confirmed after a minimum of one year's probation, which may be extended if necessary Appointee must join within one month of the appointment order; the Vice-Chancellor may extend this in exceptional circumstances Appointee must execute an agreement to abide by the Acts, Statutes, Ordinances, Rules and Regulations of the University

content_sections.text: Screening Interview All applications scrutinized by a Screening Committee for short-listing Stringent criteria may be applied while short-listing; only short-listed candidates are called for interview Interview before the Selection Committee

content_sections.text: Three sets of self-attested copies of all testimonials and supporting documents Attested copies of mark sheets, birth certificate, educational certificates and experience certificates Demand Draft or online payment receipt for the fee HSLC certificate copy for age; SC/ST certificate copy where applicable No Objection Certificate from the employer, for those in service Good character certificate from the Head of the Institution last attended or served

content_sections.text: No TA/DA for appearing in any interview or written test Incomplete applications or applications without relevant enclosures will be rejected University not responsible for postal delay or late receipt of call letters University may withdraw any post or decide not to fill it

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MUC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MUC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Assistant Professor, Department of History, 1 Internal Auditor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MUC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure A, Part III to Part V of this PDF; also on www.muoc.ac.in) and send it to The Registrar, Majuli University, Main Campus, Manika Pathar, Garamur, Majuli, Assam-785104, by speed post or registered post; page 1 also allows delivery at the registrar's office during working hours, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor (SC): Rs. 1,000. Internal Auditor (UR): Rs. 700.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 57,700 - Rs. 1,82,400 (and all other admissible allowances) for Assistant Professor, Department of History, Rs. 22,000 to 97,000 , GP Rs. 9,700 (and all other admissible allowances) for Internal Auditor.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor (History): high Second-Class Master's Degree in any branch of History with minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade, with specialized knowledge of the historical and religious literature and culture of Assam, and NET/SET pass. Internal Auditor: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce with major in Accountancy, uniformly good academic record, five years' auditing experience and working knowledge of Tally. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible Indian citizens. Internal Auditor must have working knowledge of computerized accounting including Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime. Selected candidates must be medically fit, certified by the Joint Director of Health Services of the district or a Government Medical Officer, before joining.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found indulging in canvassing in any form will be disqualified. Applications in any form other than the prescribed form will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening. Interview. All applications scrutinized by a Screening Committee for short-listing. Stringent criteria may be applied while short-listing; only short-listed candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All posts shall remain purely temporary till confirmed after a minimum of one year's probation, which may be extended if necessary. Appointee must join within one month of the appointment order; the Vice-Chancellor may extend this in exceptional circumstances. Appointee must execute an agreement to abide by the Acts, Statutes, Ordinances, Rules and Regulations of the University.
